issue.title: Add ElementType.PARAMETER to @Mock
issue.body:
Parameterized tests are becoming more common - JUnit 5 explicitly allows parameters and the sample [MockitoExtension](https://github.com/junit-team/junit5-samples/tree/master/junit5-mockito-extension/src/main/java/com/example/mockito) currently includes an @InjectMock to trigger the creation of a mock parameter.  It would be so much cleaner to use @Mock in both places.

This shouldn't be an issue for most legacy test systems since they don't allow test parameters (by default).
